title: Putnami Storage Binding
description: The resolved backend coordinates a deployer injects into a workload after provisioning a storage resource. The workload constructs a storage backend from it and transfers object bytes directly to the provider.

name.description: Logical resource name the workload requested (joins back to the manifest resource).

backend.description: Provider-neutral backend kind the workload should construct (e.g. "gcs", "s3", "file"). Open string so the protocol is not coupled to a fixed provider set.

bucket.description: Physical bucket/container the resource resolved to.

prefix.description: Optional key prefix within the bucket, e.g. a per-scope isolation prefix.

identity.description: How the workload authenticates to the provider: static credentials, or an ambient workload identity. Closed enum; adding a value requires a protocol version bump.
